description:
From: Elixir Parity. The user approved "port later" (relayed 2026-11-25). fz-mue.52 (#902) makes Macro.to_string/1 raise a named not-supported RuntimeError for now.

Goal: Macro.to_string/1 renders quoted code exactly as Elixir's formatter does. It is a faithful port of about 4,800 lines across Inspect.Algebra, Code.Normalizer and Code.Formatter, none of which exists in fz.

Children, in order: Inspect.Algebra, then Code.Identifier with Macro.classify_atom, then Code.Normalizer, then Code.Formatter, then Macro.to_string/1.

Parked until #791 (fz-mue) lands. Overlaps fz-9un (Inspect options) and the 80-column wrap tickets fz-mue.49 and fz-sc8.162, which Inspect.Algebra underlies.
title: Macro.to_string/1 renders as Elixir's formatter does
